auth_methods.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.

access.quote: For personal scripts API keys are the easiest way to access the API. Visit Security & access settings to create and manage them.

api_surface.breadth.quote: It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.

mcp.exists.quote: Linear’s MCP server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so the server is centrally hosted and managed.

buildability.main_blocker.quote: If you’re building an application for others to use, we recommend you use OAuth2 authentication.

buildability.verdict.quote: Linear’s public API is built using GraphQL.
